description: Generate types, a runtime validator, or a full handler from a learned schema — the payoff of the knowledge layer. Everything is derived from the payloads this account ACTUALLY received, with genuinely-optional fields marked optional, instead of a plausible-but-wrong guess from a model's memory of the provider docs. Pass lang for a bare type (typescript / json-schema / zod), or framework (next / express) for a ready-to-paste handler that validates and hands back a fully-typed event.

framework.description: Return a ready-to-paste handler scaffold instead of a bare type. Overrides lang.

lang.description: Output format for a bare type.

name: generate_types
